summary: Adds __reversed__ to OrderedSet correctly resolving the issue; implementation is sound. Only nit is a stray blank line added at top of file.

issues.description: Stray leading blank line added before `import copy` is unrelated to the change; minor scope/style noise but harmless.
`reversed(list(self.dict))` materializes a list copy; `reversed(self.dict)` works directly since dict is reversible (Py3.8+). Minor avoidable allocation, not incorrect.
